messages:
sarah.sales: Quick heads-up — Polaris Health sent their SIG questionnaire back and want evidence question-by-question. They flagged data residency, encryption at rest, KMS rotation, and vendor access controls as blockers. Can we assemble attachments and a short answer for each of those Qs by EOD Wed?

mike.security: On it. I can provide the KMS rotation policy excerpt and the network segmentation diagram. Will need owner for the data residency note (we have hosted + private options).

alex.platform: I can grab the deployment topology for private (VPC) and hosted. Note: hosted has region mapping table — want me to paste it here or link to the doc?

sarah.sales: Link is fine. Polaris specifically asked: "Where are customer data at rest?" and "Who can access key material?" short clear answers + artifacts please.

jen.support: I have the SOC2 + encryption-at-rest artifact URL: https://redwood-internal.docs/sig/artifacts/soc2-encrypt-v2.pdf (public copy sanitized). Also have our KMS rotation schedule snippet. Will upload that as att-1.

mike.security: Uploading KMS rotation snippet here in thread:
```
KMS Rotation: automated monthly key rotation for tenant-wrapped keys; CMKs rotated annually; rotation events logged to audit.kms-rotation index.
Access: CMK access limited to key-admin role; privileges require 2FA and TOTP enforcement.
```

sarah.sales: Perfect. For data residency: Polaris requires EU-only storage for PHI. We need an answer: hosted in eu-west-1 only (with dedicated tenant) or Private (on-prem). Alex — confirm if hosted supports region pinning + proof.

alex.platform: Confirmed: hosted supports tenant-region pinning — customers can choose eu-west-1 (see table). Evidence: `region-mapping.csv` and `tenant-region-policy.md` (public-safe excerpt attached). Link: https://redwood-internal.docs/sig/region-pinning-eu.pdf

mike.security: Also add statement about data classification: we treat PHI as high-sensitivity; storage uses AES-256-GCM at rest, DB-level encryption + disk-level encryption. I'll add the DB encryption config snippet.

jen.support: I uploaded three attachments to the shared drive and added pointers in our SIG response spreadsheet: att-1 SOC2+encrypt, att-2 KMS rotation snippet, att-3 region-pinning excerpt. Spreadsheet row IDs: R12-R15.

sarah.sales: Awesome. Polaris also asked for "vendor access controls" — they want list of roles, background checks, and third-party subprocessors. @mike.security do we have a one-pager?

mike.security: Yes — `third-party-subprocessors.pdf` and `employee-background-checks.md`. Short answer to include: "Access to customer data is limited to specific roles (oncall, infra-admin, sec-ops) with documented approvals; privileged actions require approval workflow and are audited." I'll draft a 2-line answer.

sig-bot: Reminder: SIG upload deadline in 48 hours for Polaris Health. Please attach evidentiary PDFs to the shared upload link: https://redwood-internal.docs/sig/uploads/PolarisHealth

sarah.sales: Can someone own the spreadsheet final pass? I want the completed Q-by-Q cell answers + links to attachments. I can do the final review but need content from security/platform first.

alex.platform: I'll fill the deployment and region answers by EOD today.

mike.security: I'll draft the vendor access paragraph and attach subprocessors doc by 5pm PT.

jen.support: I'll cross-check that the SOC2 cert is the latest iteration and confirm the cert date in the spreadsheet.

sarah.sales: Thanks team — I'll ping Polaris when we have the final sheet. If anyone hits a blocker, drop it here. :thumbsup:

mike.security: small note — for the KMS artifact Polaris wants the command audit snippet. Adding this sample log line: `PUT /kms/rotate key_id=abc123 user=key-admin status=success`

alex.platform: Added the `tenant-region-policy.md` excerpt into the spreadsheet R14 and included the archive link for the topology diagram.

sarah.sales: That should cover their blockers. If we finish early we can offer a short 30m call to walk-through artifacts. I'll schedule tentatively for Thu if Polaris wants it.

jen.support: All uploads done. Marking status: attachments ready.

sarah.sales: Closing action items: Mike (vendor access + KMS log), Alex (region proof + topology), Jen (SOC2 & upload verify). I will do final review Wed morning. Thanks! :raised_hands:
